I need help!
My <style="highlight">three</style> beloved <style="highlight">white pigeons</style> have gone missing! They were the only things left behind by my late grandfather, and they mean more to me than my own life!
All three of them have a <style="highlight">note</style> tied to their legs as a marker. If you happen to see them, please get in touch with me! A generous reward awaits!
<align="right">A Heartbroken Pigeon Keeper
document:597.source_cn:
好心人，请帮帮我！
本人不慎弄丢了<style="highlight">三只</style>心爱的<style="highlight">白鸽</style>，它们是我已故祖父留下的唯一念想，对我来说比生命还重要！
三只白鸽的腿上都绑上了作为标记的<style="highlight">纸条</style>，如果有谁见到了它们，请务必联系本人！本人必有重谢！
<align="right">心碎养鸽人
